name: 豆蜂运营工作台
description: Manage Douyin account diagnosis, research, ideas, publishing checklists, comments and performance reviews.
description_zh: 用自然语言管理抖音账号诊断、推荐流研究、选题脚本、发布清单、评论草稿和效果复盘。
description_en: Manage Douyin account diagnosis, research, ideas, publishing checklists, comments and performance reviews with natural language.
examples_zh: 给我的账号做一次五维诊断并保存
根据这批推荐流观察生成 3 个原创选题
创建一条发布前检查清单
汇总最近视频数据并给出下一轮实验
examples_en: Diagnose my account and save the result
Create three original ideas from my feed research
Review recent video metrics and suggest the next experiment
